regions.name: Cambrian Mountains, Wales
regions.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025. ESA/CDSE quarterly mosaics; Taylor Geospatial Engine mirror. RGB bands B04/B03/B02, 10-metre source resolution, July-September 2025 with April-June 2025 filling missing observations.
regions.processing: Fill Q3 nodata from Q2, then WGS84 bilinear reprojection to 1800x1800; all three bands have 100% valid coverage. Reflectance DN 0..3000 scaled to 0..255 with exponent 0.7; JPEG quality 94.

regions.name: Wales Sentinel tile 01
regions.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025. ESA/CDSE quarterly mosaics; Taylor Geospatial Engine mirror. RGB B04/B03/B02, 10-metre source resolution.
regions.processing: Q3 valid observations over Q2; WGS84 bilinear reprojection; 3600-square tiles overlap by four per cent. DN 0..3000 scaled to 0..255 with exponent 0.7; JPEG quality 94. Tile 01 is the Wales-wide overview.
